history.text: I've got a few hours this afternoon and I want to write something if there's anything worth responding to. What's happening in the AI / devtools discourse today?
Let me scan what's been moving. Anything you're specifically hoping is happening, or fully open?
Fully open. But remember — I only want to write if I have a differentiated angle. If everyone's already said what I'd say, I'd rather skip it and work on the newsletter instead.
Understood. I'll flag what's live and tell you where the gap is — or if there isn't one.
Also if someone responds to my agent frameworks piece from last week, I want to know. That thread might still have life in it.
I'll keep an eye on responses to that piece too.
Cool. I'll be writing — ping me if something's time-sensitive or if you find a good hook for the junior dev hiring thing I've been sitting on.
Will do. I'll stay quiet unless there's something worth your afternoon.
